housing_pipeline.description: The project proposes demolition of two existing single-family homes and the construction of nine new buildings containing a total of 20 residential units. The new development will be four stories and will include units of various sizes (studio, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and 4-bedroom). Two units will be designated as affordable at 80% AMI.

The proposed project involves the remodel of an existing restaurant and offices to incorporate a mixed-use conversion. The existing Formula Retail restaurant, Burger King, will remain while the existing office space will be converted into nine residential units. In addition, a 1.5-story, vertical addition with a total of four stories will be constructed to accommodate the new residential units. The proposed project employs SB-423 for streamlined approval and the California State Density Bonus law to increase the allowable unit density by 80% of base density (five units), totaling nine units. The project additionally requests waivers and incentives to achieve the additional units.

Priority Project per ED 13-01
Demolition of an existing mortuary and construction of a new 98 unit 100% affordable senior housing building with a ground floor neighborhood commercial space. No parking provided

The development will replace the existing grocery store with a new larger grocery store and mixed-income apartments. The ground floor program includes approximately 63,000 square feet of retail space (grocery) fronting Fulton Street along with residential lobby and support functions. Upper floors will provide 562 dwelling units in a mix of unit types. 

The development will include 20% of the total units (112 units) serving 50-80% AMI levels of population.

The project proposes to demolish the existing theater structure and construct a new eight‑story, 83‑unit mixed‑use building. The project includes for‑sale residential condominium units, ground‑floor commercial/retail space, and associated common open space and building amenities
